name: youtube-agent
description: Fifteen Claude skills and two agents that run a YouTube channel: scripts off 21 hook formulas with a scored hook, title and thumbnail linted as one pairing, an edit decision list, a retention reader, a channel audit that names the one fix from your Studio export, A/B test significance, a sponsorship rate card from your median views, Shorts, chapters, search, comments, the weekly plan exported to your calendar, a virality engine, a voice profiler from your transcripts, and a one-command pre-publish check.
